title: Structure and function of the Si3 insertion integrated into the trigger loop/helix of cyanobacterial RNA polymerase
authors: Zuhaib Qayyum M; Imashimizu M; Leanca M; Vishwakarma RK; Riaz-Bradley A; Yuzenkova Y; Murakami KS
one_liner_zh: 该文解析蓝藻RNA聚合酶Si3插入域的结构与功能，涉及RNA聚合酶-DNA/RNA互作的结构机制，但非TF-DNA转录因子结合体系，且方法以结构解析为主，无AI或MD模拟建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract:
Cyanobacteria and evolutionarily related chloroplasts of algae and plants possess unique RNA polymerases (RNAPs) with characteristics that distinguish from canonical bacterial RNAPs. The largest subunit of cyanobacterial RNAP (cyRNAP) is divided into two polypeptides, β’1 and β’2, and contains the largest known lineage-specific insertion domain, Si3, located in the middle of the trigger loop and spans approximately half of the β’2 subunit. In this study, we present the X-ray crystal structure of Si3 and the cryo-EM structures of the cyRNAP transcription elongation complex plus the NusG factor with and without incoming nucleoside triphosphate (iNTP) bound at the active site. Si3 has a well-ordered and elongated shape that exceeds the length of the main body of cyRNAP, fits into cavities of cyRNAP and shields the binding site of secondary channel-binding proteins such as Gre and DksA. A small transition from the trigger loop to the trigger helix upon iNTP binding at the active site results in a large swing motion of Si3; however, this transition does not affect the catalytic activity of cyRNAP due to its minimal contact with cyRNAP, NusG or DNA. This study provides a structural framework for understanding the evolutionary significance of these features unique to cyRNAP and chloroplast RNAP and may provide insights into the molecular mechanism of transcription in specific environment of photosynthetic organisms.

Significance statement

Cellular RNA polymerase (RNAP) carries out RNA synthesis and proofreading reactions utilizing a mobile catalytic domain known as the trigger loop/helix. In cyanobacteria, this essential domain acquired a large Si3 insertion during the course of evolution. Despite its elongated shape and large swinging motion associated with the transition between the trigger loop and helix, Si3 is effectively accommodated within cyRNAP, with no impact on the fundamental functions of the trigger loop. Understanding the significance of Si3 in cyanobacteria and chloroplasts is expected to reveal unique transcription mechanism in photosynthetic organisms.
abstract_zh:
蓝藻及其进化上相关的藻类和植物叶绿体拥有独特的RNA聚合酶（RNAPs），其特性区别于典型的细菌RNA聚合酶。蓝藻RNA聚合酶（cyRNAP）的最大亚基被分为两个多肽，β'1和β'2，并包含已知最大的谱系特异性插入结构域Si3，该结构域位于触发环中部，跨越β'2亚基约一半长度。在本研究中，我们展示了Si3的X射线晶体结构，以及cyRNAP转录延伸复合物与NusG因子在有无进入的核苷三磷酸（iNTP）结合于活性位点时的冷冻电镜结构。Si3具有高度有序且细长的形状，超过cyRNAP主体长度，嵌入cyRNAP的腔隙中，并遮蔽了次级通道结合蛋白（如Gre和DksA）的结合位点。当iNTP结合于活性位点时，从触发环到触发螺旋的小幅转变导致Si3发生大幅摆动；然而，由于Si3与cyRNAP、NusG或DNA的接触极少，这种转变不影响cyRNAP的催化活性。本研究为理解cyRNAP和叶绿体RNAP所特有的这些特征的进化意义提供了结构框架，并可能为光合生物特定环境中的转录分子机制提供见解。

意义声明

细胞RNA聚合酶（RNAP）利用称为触发环/螺旋的可移动催化结构域执行RNA合成和校对反应。在蓝藻中，这一关键结构域在进化过程中获得了大的Si3插入。尽管Si3具有细长形状，并伴随触发环与螺旋之间的转变产生大幅摆动，但它被有效地容纳在cyRNAP内，对触发环的基本功能无影响。理解Si3在蓝藻和叶绿体中的意义，有望揭示光合生物中独特的转录机制。
